steps: Given: Mass of person, m = 80 kg; acceleration due to gravity on Earth, gₑ = 10 m s⁻²; acceleration due to gravity on Moon, gₘ = 1.6 m s⁻².
Required: Weight on Earth and weight on Moon.
Formula: Weight, W = mg.
On Earth: Wₑ = mgₑ = 80 kg × 10 m s⁻² = 800 N.
On Moon: Wₘ = mgₘ = 80 kg × 1.6 m s⁻² = 128 N.
items.finalAnswer: Weight on Earth = 800 N; weight on Moon = 128 N.

steps: Given: Mass of car, m = 800 kg; initial velocity, u = 10 m s⁻¹; final velocity, v = 30 m s⁻¹; time, t = 10 s.
Required: Force, F.
Formula: a = (v − u)/t and F = ma.
Substitution: a = (30 m s⁻¹ − 10 m s⁻¹)/10 s = 2 m s⁻².
Working: F = 800 kg × 2 m s⁻² = 1600 N.
Given: Mass of bullet, m₁ = 5 g = 0.005 kg; velocity of bullet, v₁ = 300 m s⁻¹; mass of gun, m₂ = 10 kg. Initially, both are at rest.
Required: Recoil velocity of the gun, v₂.
Formula: By the law of conservation of momentum, total momentum before firing = total momentum after firing.
Substitution: 0 = m₁v₁ + m₂v₂.
Working: v₂ = −(m₁v₁)/m₂ = −(0.005 kg × 300 m s⁻¹)/(10 kg) = −0.15 m s⁻¹.
The negative sign shows that the gun moves opposite to the bullet.
Given: Mass of astronaut, mₐ = 70 kg; mass of wrench, m𝓌 = 300 g = 0.3 kg; velocity of wrench, v𝓌 = 3.5 m s⁻¹. Initially, both are at rest.
Required: Recoil velocity of the astronaut, vₐ.
Formula: By the law of conservation of momentum, total momentum before throwing = total momentum after throwing.
Substitution: 0 = m𝓌v𝓌 + mₐvₐ.
Working: vₐ = −(m𝓌v𝓌)/mₐ = −(0.3 kg × 3.5 m s⁻¹)/(70 kg) = −0.015 m s⁻¹ = −1.5 × 10⁻² m s⁻¹.
The negative sign shows that the astronaut recoils in the direction opposite to the wrench.
Given: Recoil speed of the astronaut, v = 1.5 × 10⁻² m s⁻¹; time, t = 30 min = 1800 s.
Required: Distance covered by the astronaut, d.
Formula: d = vt.
Substitution: d = 1.5 × 10⁻² m s⁻¹ × 1800 s.
Working: d = 27 m.
Given: Mass of first bogie, m₁ = 6.5 × 10³ kg; velocity of first bogie, u₁ = 0.8 m s⁻¹; mass of second bogie, m₂ = 9.2 × 10³ kg; velocity of second bogie, u₂ = 1.2 m s⁻¹.
Required: Common velocity, v, after the bogies couple.
Formula: By the law of conservation of momentum, m₁u₁ + m₂u₂ = (m₁ + m₂)v.
Substitution: (6.5 × 10³ kg × 0.8 m s⁻¹) + (9.2 × 10³ kg × 1.2 m s⁻¹) = (6.5 × 10³ kg + 9.2 × 10³ kg)v.
Given: Mass of cyclist = 55 kg; mass of bicycle = 5 kg; applied force, F = 90 N; time of acceleration, t₁ = 8 s; time at constant speed, t₂ = 8 s; initial velocity, u = 0 m s⁻¹.
Required: Total distance travelled.
Formula: Total mass, m = mass of cyclist + mass of bicycle; F = ma; s = ut + ½at²; and distance at constant speed = vt.
Substitution: m = 55 kg + 5 kg = 60 kg; a = F/m = 90 N/60 kg = 1.5 m s⁻².
Distance in the first 8 s: s₁ = ut₁ + ½at₁² = 0 + ½ × 1.5 m s⁻² × (8 s)² = 48 m.
Velocity after 8 s: v = u + at₁ = 0 + 1.5 m s⁻² × 8 s = 12 m s⁻¹.
Distance in the next 8 s: s₂ = vt₂ = 12 m s⁻¹ × 8 s = 96 m.
Total distance = s₁ + s₂ = 48 m + 96 m = 144 m.
Given: Mass of ball, m = 0.4 kg; height from which it is dropped, h₁ = 1.8 m; rebound height, h₂ = 0.8 m; acceleration due to gravity, g = 10 m s⁻².
Required: Magnitude and direction of impulse applied to the ball by the floor.
Take upward as the positive direction.
Formula: v² = u² + 2as; impulse = change in momentum = m(v − u).
Velocity just before hitting the floor: u = −√(2gh₁) = −√(2 × 10 m s⁻² × 1.8 m) = −6 m s⁻¹.
Velocity just after rebounding: v = +√(2gh₂) = +√(2 × 10 m s⁻² × 0.8 m) = +4 m s⁻¹.
Impulse = m(v − u) = 0.4 kg × [4 m s⁻¹ − (−6 m s⁻¹)] = 4 N s.
The positive sign shows that the impulse is upward.
